neighbours.label: ' in' / ' from' introducing an ambient outdoor element (swaying in the breeze, dried in the sun, relief from the heat)
fire: Laundry hung on the line, waving gently in the wind.
The tomatoes were left to ripen in the sun for a week.
Tall grass bent and swayed in the evening breeze.
Hikers sought shelter from the rain under a rock ledge.
The old fishing boats rocked in the wind at their moorings.
We sat on the porch, baking in the afternoon sun.
The kites danced in the breeze above the beach.
Cattle huddled together for protection from the cold wind.
quiet: Laundry hung on the line, folded neatly by the back door.
The tomatoes were left to ripen on the kitchen shelf for a week.
Tall grass grew along the fence behind the barn.
Hikers sought a map at the visitor centre before leaving.
The old fishing boats were painted at the end of the season.
We sat on the porch, talking about the afternoon.
The kites were sold at a stall above the beach.
Cattle huddled together near the gate of the field.
